before: Commercial truck crashes on I-95 through McIntosh and Glynn counties are among the most severe crashes in the region. Fatigue is a major factor — many truck drivers have been on the road for extended hours by the time they reach this corridor, and federal hours-of-service rules (49 C.F.R. § 395.3) cap how long they may drive. When a fatigued truck driver causes a crash at highway speed, the injuries to occupants of passenger vehicles are frequently catastrophic, including traumatic brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, and fatalities.
